newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Mobil S'pore refinery back to 280,000 bpd.
newsitem.headline: Mobil S'pore refinery back to 280,000 bpd.

text.p: Mobil has returned its 280,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) Singapore refinery back to maximum capacity two weeks ago on improved margins, a company spokesman said on Friday.
The spokesman said the decision was made as refining margins were "more reasonable".
Mobil had reduced operations at its Jurong refinery in mid-June by 10,000 bpd due to weaker margins.
Two other refineries in Singapore followed suit to cut runs but on Monday, Shell resumed its full output of 435,000 bpd at its Pulau Bukom refinery, also on improved margins.
Shell had cut runs at its 200,000 bpd crude unit in early August by 80 percent.
Traders said only Esso Singapore, an affiliate of U.S. Exxon Corp remained to increase its output to 230,000 bpd after cutting runs by 15 percent in early July.
